BillHeading.Sponsors: Senate Early Learning & K-12 Education (originally sponsored by Senators Hunt, Wilson, C., and O'Ban)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Declaring September the month of the kindergartner.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to declaring September the month of the kindergartner; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.150 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28A.150 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: September is the month of the kindergartner. Each September elementary schools are encouraged to determine a method to celebrate new kindergartners as they begin their life in K-12 education.
